stem: The data of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription, runs to September 2026. In its retention triangle the July 2026 cohort shows 0% in month 6. What does this cell mean?

options.text: It cannot be known yet: month 6 is January 2027, so it should be missing
Every business of the July cohort cancelled within its first 6 months
All of the July businesses moved to Business Care Year, which drops them
The July cohort is too young to have any businesses in it yet
